verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs describe an official hosted MCP URL that agents can connect to manually or through a native integration. They also name 'the monday MCP' for Claude, Copilot and ChatGPT, plus a separate developer MCP for scaffolding and deploying apps from chat. Missing for 10: detailed MCP docs (exposed tools, auth flow, setup steps) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use our native integration, or manually connect with our hosted MCP url.
Work with tools like Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT through official integrations or the monday MCP
Bring an agent in once and reach it from Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, our MCP, or the API.
Connect the developer MCP to any agent.
